say:1:1530824001:1.text: My job is to make sure no one jumps into the pit.
say:1:1530824001:1.source_cn: 彩羽守在这里，防止跳坑。
say:1:1530824001:1.male: My job is to make sure no one jumps into the pit.
say:1:1530824001:1.female: My job is to make sure no one jumps into the pit.

say:2:1530824002:1.text: Rumor has it there's a utopia at the bottom, which is why a lot of people come here and try to jump in.
say:2:1530824002:1.source_cn: 传说深坑下面是什么理想乡，有不少人来跳坑。
